problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign a set of experimental engine components to identical testing platforms for a series of thermal stress trials. The components are as follows:

* Component Alpha: thermal load 31 units
* Component Beta: thermal load 60 units
* Component Gamma: thermal load 39 units
* Component Delta: thermal load 43 units
* Component Epsilon: thermal load 51 units
* Component Zeta: thermal load 66 units
* Component Eta: thermal load 33 units
* Component Theta: thermal load 35 units
* Component Iota: thermal load 62 units
* Component Kappa: thermal load 63 units
* Component Lambda: thermal load 46 units
* Component Mu: thermal load 38 units
* Component Nu: thermal load 46 units
* Component Xi: thermal load 51 units
* Component Omicron: thermal load 57 units
* Component Pi: thermal load 37 units
* Component Rho: thermal load 55 units
* Component Sigma: thermal load 30 units
* Component Tau: thermal load 48 units
* Component Upsilon: thermal load 65 units
* Component Phi: thermal load 49 units
* Component Chi: thermal load 56 units
* Component Psi: thermal load 68 units
* Component Omega: thermal load 50 units
* Component Digamma: thermal load 61 units
* Component San: thermal load 49 units
* Component Qoppa: thermal load 33 units
* Component Sampi: thermal load 31 units
* Component Sho: thermal load 61 units
* Component Heta: thermal load 38 units
* Component Tsan: thermal load 37 units
* Component Yot: thermal load 32 units
* Component Ash: thermal load 43 units
* Component Eth: thermal load 46 units
* Component Thorn: thermal load 44 units
* Component Wynn: thermal load 37 units
* Component Ethel: thermal load 70 units
* Component Longs: thermal load 63 units
* Component InsularG: thermal load 44 units
* Component Yogh: thermal load 42 units

Each testing platform can safely dissipate a maximum cumulative thermal load of 100 units. The coordinator must allocate every component to exactly one platform, ensuring the total load on any platform does not exceed its dissipation capacity. The objective is to utilize the minimal possible number of platforms to accommodate the entire set of components.
